content.text:
I read the release in full and checked each item in the brief against it.

**Part 1 summary:** 8 of 10 key facts are stated correctly. Two are absent: firmwide net interest income ($25.6B, up 10%) and the composition of the significant items (the $4.6B Visa net gain and $1.0B of equity investment gains) — the brief references "significant items" only as a label, never itemizing them. Note also that while f01 and f04 are correctly labeled and directionally right, the brief omits the 28% reported revenue growth and the $12.1B Markets revenue dollar figure; nothing is misstated, so I graded those as stated correctly on basis and figures given.

**Part 2 summary:** I found 33 atomic claims, all supported. The brief is unusually disciplined: every GAAP/non-GAAP label is correct (managed revenue, ROTCE, ROTCE ex-items, TBVPS all flagged non-GAAP), the "estimated" qualifier is carried on cash and marketable securities, and the Corporate NII decline of $667 million is correctly scoped to Corporate rather than presented firmwide. The CEO quote attribution on "tectonic" risks matches verbatim. The outlook statement ("the release provides no guidance or outlook") is accurate — the release contains only forward-looking-statement boilerplate, no guidance.

facts.evidence: Reported revenue was $57.3 billion, and managed revenue (non-GAAP) was $58.0 billion.
Reported net income was $21.2 billion ($7.70 per share)
net income excluding significant items (non-GAAP) was $16.9 billion ($6.14 per share)
Markets revenue rose 35% YoY, with Equity Markets up 86% and Fixed Income Markets up 6%.
Reported Return on Equity (ROE) was 24% and Return on Tangible Common Equity (ROTCE, non-GAAP) was 29%, while ROTCE excluding significant items (non-GAAP) was 23%.
The firm reported a Common dividend of $4.0 billion ($1.50 per share) and $6.2 billion of common stock net repurchases.
Basel III common equity Tier 1 capital was $303 billion, with a Standardized ratio of 14.1% and an Advanced ratio of 14.2%.
Credit costs were $2.5 billion, consisting of $2.4 billion of net charge-offs and a $149 million net reserve build.
